nodes.description: Payable receive() fallback that lets the contract accept plain Ether transfers; holds no logic and no access control.
External bait(address _pickpocket) function that delegatecalls an entirely caller-supplied address and requires the call to succeed.
Caller-supplied address parameter used directly as the delegatecall target without any whitelist or validation.
delegatecall(abi.encodeWithSignature("finesse(address)", _pickpocket)) executed on an arbitrary address, giving the callee full control of Bait's storage, balance and code context.

edges.reason: bait() unconditionally reaches the delegatecall with no validation or guard, so the attacker-chosen callee executes arbitrary code (including re-entering Bait) inside the contract's own context.
The attacker-controlled _pickpocket parameter flows directly into the delegatecall target, making the executed code and its reentrant behaviour fully attacker-defined.
bait() binds its external argument to the local parameter _pickpocket before use.
receive() keeps the contract funded with Ether, supplying the balance that the delegatecall callee can drain during the unsafe delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter _pickpocket has no independent semantics: it exists only as the direct sink of the delegatecall target, so it should be absorbed into the delegatecall unsafe_operation node.
